arabic text: BANDH ANKHIYAN KARNA KAWE BHEN TERI AY SHAAM\nBANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text: Close your eyes, my brother, your sister says;\nShaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text: ME VENDHI RAYIAN HUR ZARB TERI\nAY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text: I have endured every blow meant for you;\nShaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
NO LAKH DA MAJMA MERE KULLE WAALE ABID TO
PUCHLE TURNA MUHALLE
TERI SONI NIBHGAYI HUN WAARI MERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
Ask my bareheaded Abid how impossible it was
to walk through a crowd of nine hundred thousand.
Your beautiful sacrifice is complete; now it is my turn.
Shaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
PEDAL TURA KE US NU LE AWO PUCHADA YAZIDE ME
NU DASSA O
ESS KAFILE VICH ZAINAB HAI KERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
Bring him forward on foot,
Yazid commands, so that I may ask:
Tell me, which one in this caravan is Zainab?
Shaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
CHELUM MANAWAN KARBAL CHI AAYI GHAL LA
KABAR NU KAVE ZAHRA JAYI
TAKTEE VE UJRI HAI BEHN TERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
I came to Karbala for the fortieth
day and embraced your grave.
Zahra’s daughter says: Look—your ruined sister has returned.
Shaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
FIZA DE WARIS VI AYE NANA ZAINAB DA WARIS
AYAA KOYI NA
SIRR NANGE RONDHI RAI DHI HAI TERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
O Grandfather, Fizza had protectors,
but no protector came for Zainab.
Your daughter kept weeping with her head uncovered.
Shaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
ENJ HASSAN LUTEYA ZAHRA DA GARIYE GHORE DE
GAL VICH GHAZI DA SARIYE
DASSA MUSIBAT ME KERI KERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
Thus was Zahra’s household plundered.
A horse’s neck carried Ghazi’s severed head.
How can I recount every calamity?
Shaam has become my battlefield.

arabic text:
HAR JATE VEERAN PATHAR ME KANDHI GIRJANDA
DAI ABID USS NU UTHANDI
HO VEER GHAYAI VIRAN BA TERI
AY SHAAM BANGAYI MAKTAL HAI MERI
english translation text:
At every place, stones struck the caravan.
Whenever Abid fell, I lifted him again.
O brother, your sister was left utterly alone.
Shaam has become my battlefield.
